#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

echo "Applying security policies to workspace..."

ROOT="/workspace"

if [[ ! -d "$ROOT" ]]; then
  echo "Workspace directory not found: $ROOT" >&2
  exit 1
fi

# Do not touch VCS metadata if present
PRUNE_GIT=( -path "$ROOT/.git" -prune )

# Set directory permissions: 750
find "$ROOT" \( "${PRUNE_GIT[@]}" \) -o -type d -print0 | xargs -0r chmod 750

# Set default file permissions: 640
find "$ROOT" \( "${PRUNE_GIT[@]}" \) -o -type f -print0 | xargs -0r chmod 640

# Ensure executables are 750 (existing exec bit or shebang)
find "$ROOT" \( "${PRUNE_GIT[@]}" \) -o -type f -perm /111 -print0 | xargs -0r chmod 750
while IFS= read -r -d '' f; do
  if head -n1 "$f" 2>/dev/null | grep -qE '^#!'; then
    chmod 750 "$f"
  fi
done < <(find "$ROOT" \( "${PRUNE_GIT[@]}" \) -o -type f -print0)

# Sensitive files: 600
SENSITIVE_PATTERNS=(
  "*.key" "*.pem" "*.crt" "*.pfx" "*.p12"
  ".env" "*.env" "*.env.*"
  "id_rsa" "id_dsa" "id_ecdsa" "id_ed25519"
)
for pat in "${SENSITIVE_PATTERNS[@]}"; do
  find "$ROOT" -type f -name "$pat" -exec chmod 600 {} +
done

# Keep this script executable
chmod 750 "$0"

echo "Security policies applied."
